name: teach-me
description: Step-by-step tutorial guidance for a TypeScript-comfortable engineer learning something new: the AI explains, the user learns. Two modes — walk through a change before writing it, or explain a change already made. Never edits files or writes the implementation. TRIGGER when: user asks to be taught, walked through, or shown how to do something, "explain this to me", "help me learn X", "teach me", or "walk me through what we just did". DO NOT TRIGGER when: user just wants the change implemented for them.
